transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, what finally pushed me to come in is that I'm having a lot of trouble staying focused at work. I can sit down to start an EPIC quality report, or go into a clinic metrics meeting with every intention of tracking what's going on, but... within just a few minutes, my mind has drifted completely. It gets so far off track that I’ll catch myself rereading the exact same numbers over and over, or I'll suddenly realize I missed the entire point of the discussion. It's just becoming a real problem for me.
Did you have this kind of trouble paying attention when you were a child?

Yes, I did. Even back in elementary school, I remember my teachers writing on my report cards that I was bright but careless. And at home, my mother actually had to sit with me while I finished my homework. If she wasn't right there keeping me on task, I would just lose track of my assignments, or I'd realize I completely forgot to bring my books home from school. So, yes, it's been an issue for a long time.
Do these focus problems also affect you outside of work?

Yes, they definitely do. Outside of work, I help out with these volunteer health workshops, but... well, I’ve actually had to step back from leading parts of them recently. I just found that I can’t reliably keep all the planning pieces moving. And honestly, the impact at my job is getting worse, too. My delays have started affecting our clinic reporting deadlines, which ends up making other teams wait on me. It's just becoming a real issue across the board.
Do you also have this same trouble staying focused during everyday conversations?

Yes, I do. Even when someone is speaking right to me. Like, when a medical director or one of my coordinators is talking directly to me, I’ll be looking right at them and nodding along... but then I end up having to ask them to repeat the action item. It's like the words just didn’t stay with me at all.
Do you often misplace or lose everyday items like your keys, phone, or paperwork?

Yes, I do. I feel like I’m constantly hunting for my work badge, my handwritten notes, or clinic folders. Sometimes it’s even the flash drive I literally just had in my hand right before a meeting. It’s really embarrassing, honestly, because I used to be the organized one.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety, like it’s hard to sit still?

No, not really. I don't have much trouble sitting still. I can sit at my desk or in long clinic meetings without feeling like I need to get up and move around. My mind might be somewhere else entirely, but physically... no, I wouldn't say I feel restless or fidgety.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about many different things?

No, I wouldn't say I worry excessively. I mean, I have normal stress from work—managing a clinic is demanding—but I don't sit around feeling anxious or worrying about a bunch of different things all the time. It's really just the focus and organization issues that are bothering me.
